title: 4 Swings, Each One Higher… How Many Bricks Come Out?
description:
Comment your number 👇
A steel wrecking ball on a 7.6 m cable swings into a wall of 172 bricks four times, released from 22, 38, 56, 80 degrees. A higher release means a faster ball: 12, 20, 29, 40 km/h at impact.
Every brick is a real rigid body in a Blender physics simulation, and the count is measured, not picked: a brick counts once it ends up more than 30 cm from where it was laid.
Made by Predixel: I set the swings, the simulation decides the rest. No footage, samples or stock media.
#simulation #physics #satisfying
